newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NBM Amstelland to sell roof materials unit.
newsitem.headline: NBM Amstelland to sell roof materials unit.

text.p: Builder NBM Amstelland said on Monday it was negotiating the sale of its roofing products subsidiary Filamat to building materials firm M.C.I. of France.

"NBM-Amstelland and M.C.I. (Materiaux de Construction International, part of the Saint-Gobain Group ) have started talks on the acquisition by M.C.I. of all shares in Filamat BV of Hardewijk," the company said in a statement.
It said Filamat, part of the Cementbouw group bought by NBM-Amstelland last year, was not a core activity.
Filamat posted turnover of seven million guilders last year. The company manufactures products under licence from Saint Gobain and employs 25 people.
The transaction would not affect NBM-Amstelland's profit forecast for 1996, which envisages a 15 percent growth in profits per share from last year's 2.38 guilders.
